name: sama-lingerie
description: Single-page, bilingual (EN / AR, RTL) site for Sama Lingerie, Saida, Lebanon. No build step: plain HTML + CSS + JS. GSAP 3 (ScrollTrigger) and Lenis are loaded from CDNs.

scripts.dev: node deploy-stage.mjs && npx wrangler pages dev dist-site
scripts.deploy: node deploy-stage.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy dist-site --project-name sama-lingerie
